answers.bix-9-q3: In the dentate gyrus (using p < 0.05, |log2FC| > 0.5, baseMean > 10, Control as reference): 509 genes are DE in good vs control, 129 in bad vs control, and 194 in good vs bad. There is substantial but incomplete overlap: 42 genes are DE in both good vs control and bad vs control; 85 genes are shared between good vs control and good vs bad; 34 between bad vs control and good vs bad; and 11 genes are DE in all three contrasts simultaneously. Thus, there is a mix of unique and shared DEGs, with only a small core set common to all three groups (no complete overlap, but clear partial overlaps among pairs and a small three-way overlap).
